lines.speaker: CURATOR
lines.text: Docent units one through sixteen: offline.

lines.speaker: CURATOR
lines.text: Enter the wing. Locate the anchor relic. Restore exhibit loop integrity. Remove contradictions.

lines.speaker: CURATOR
lines.text: Objects, persons, memories, or events that do not belong.

lines.speaker: SEV
lines.text: And if the contradiction is alive?

lines.speaker: WARDEN HALVIK
lines.text: By order of the Sainted Bell, Hallowmere is sealed.

lines.speaker: ACOLYTE
lines.text: The Warden has forbidden treatment of the marked.

lines.speaker: MIRA
lines.text: The Warden has forbidden rain before. It still fell.

lines.speaker: MIRA
lines.text: I answer to fevers, wounds, and mothers holding dying children. Your Warden can wait in line.

lines.speaker: MIRA
lines.text: I am going back under the chapel.

lines.speaker: SEV
lines.text: That is where the breach is.

lines.speaker: MIRA
lines.text: That is where the sick went.

lines.speaker: MIRA
lines.text: White walls. Metal beds. Glass bottles.

lines.speaker: MIRA
lines.text: Then why does it feel like a place that makes sickness?

lines.speaker: CURATOR
lines.text: The hospital segment is not part of the Plague Wing.

lines.speaker: SEV
lines.text: A lie with a bell around it.

lines.speaker: MIRA
lines.text: And now it is a reward?

lines.speaker: CURATOR
lines.text: Memory Card acquired: The Bell Saint.

lines.speaker: MIRA
lines.text: Do not make it sound clean.

mira: Rot has rules. I know them.
